latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free YouTube Video Editor skill.

- Upload and edit YouTube videos for free with cloud-based GPU processing (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/WebM/AVI).
- Automatically handles user authentication and anonymous token setup.
- Supports timeline editing, adding audio/text overlays, and exporting 1080p MP4 videos without watermark.
- Provides clear error handling and status updates throughout the editing and export workflow.
- Uses session-based operations to allow multiple uploads, previews, and iterative edits in one session.
- Built-in intent recognition for exports, credits, uploads, and editing actions.
